name: previs
description: Previs — logiciel de prévisionnel financier piloté par LLM (TARN COMPTA)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @previs/core && npm run build -w @previs/server && npm run build -w @previs/mcp && npm run build -w @previs/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @previs/server" "npm run dev -w @previs/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @previs/core && npm run test -w @previs/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @previs/core && npm run typecheck -w @previs/server && npm run typecheck -w @previs/mcp && npm run typecheck -w @previs/web
